description_html:
OPCODE is an assembly-language programming competition that tests participants' ability to think at the machine level. Unlike high-level programming contests, OPCODE demands precision at the instruction layer; Every register choice, every branch, and every memory access counts.

 

The competition is structured around two core challenges:

  • Debugging Challenge: Participants are given a pre-written ARM assembly program that contains deliberate bugs. The task is to identify and fix all errors so that the program produces correct output.
  • Algorithm Implementation Challenge: Participants must implement a given algorithm entirely in ARM assembly, achieving the optimal time and space complexity.

 

Solutions are not merely judged on correctness; resource efficiency is paramount. Programs that produce correct output but waste instructions, registers, or memory will be penalised in the scoring.
location: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Kancheepuram
